recent_articles.title: Govt committed to responsive governance, grassroots development: Deputy CM

recent_articles.title: Haryana government has assured to maintain 1,000 cusecs of water supply through Munak Canal: Delhi CM | Delhi News - The Indian Express

recent_articles.title: Odisha Govt Sanctions Rs 1.08 Cr For Sital Sasthi Festival In Sambalpur | OdishaBytes

recent_articles.title: A.P. primary teachers body elects new office-bearers - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Div Com Kashmir reviews Amarnath Yatra arrangements in Pahalgam

recent_articles.title: MLA demands immediate launch of phase II seawall construction in Chellanam - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Kerala CM directs withdrawal of suspension order of school Principal - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Tangedco replaces electrical poles damaged by strong winds in Tiruvannamalai - The Hindu

The city experienced moderate wind speeds of 32 km/h, causing the uprooting of trees, hoardings, and banners. VMC staff cleared debris using both its own vehicles and private earth movers. Power disruptions were also reported in several areas. **VMC Commissioner Dhyana Chandra H.M.** monitored the situation and directed officials to address waterlogging concerns promptly.

recent_articles.title: Residents block key stretch near Katpadi demanding resumption of water supply - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Residents** of **Melpadi village**, near Katpadi in Vellore, blocked **Tiruvallala Main Road** on Sunday demanding immediate resumption of water supply for household consumption. The villagers, who rely on the **Katpadi Panchayat Union** for water, have been facing irregular supply due to a malfunctioning motor pump and disconnected pipelines at the newly built Over Head Tank (OHT).  Panchayat officials are working to provide temporary water through private tanker lorries before resuming water supply through the new OHT.

recent_articles.title: Tigress which killed four women trapped in Maharashtra - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Forest officials** tranquilized a tigress that killed four women in Maharashtra's Chandrapur district. The attack occurred while the women were harvesting tendu patta leaves, and three of them went searching for missing companions.  The deceased are Kavdabai Mohurle (45), Anitabai Mohurle (40), Sunita Mohurle (38), and Sangeeta Chaudhary (50). The incident has sparked anger among residents who have been living in fear due to previous tiger attacks, highlighting the escalating human-tiger conflict.

recent_articles.title: Choppadandi MLA Medipally Sathyam intervenes to speed up paddy lifting process, mitigate woes of farmers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Medipally Sathyam**, **MLA** of Choppadandi, personally intervened in the paddy lifting process at various procurement centres in Karimnagar district.  Responding to reported vehicle shortages, he persuaded lorry owners to deploy their vehicles for paddy transportation and even boarded a truck to oversee the lifting process at one centre. Local farmers expressed gratitude for Sathyam's efforts in accelerating the paddy collection and alleviating their concerns.
